summary: Truncated handshake packet panics the client before TLS starts; a network attacker can crash apps that use tls=true
Failed `LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE` leaves unread results on the connection, so a later query can receive another request's rows

vulnerabilities.vulnerable_version_range: `<= 1.10.1` (the leak needs `compress`, which exists from v1.9.0 onward)
